architecture_notes: Static analysis owns symbols and edges as ground truth; the Interpreter owns meaning
Pipeline: repo → Extractor → SymbolGraph → Interpreter → UnitGraph → Differ → DeltaGraph, served from .scv/ by the server to the web UI
SymbolGraph is deterministic and cached by file blob hash; UnitGraph (snapshot) is the visualizer's contract; DeltaGraph is the diff of two snapshots plus risk
3D is a skin over the same layout engine, never a fork
LLM provider is pluggable: Ollama (local, default) or Anthropic, same prompts and schema
